note: City of Bowman campground run by Bowman Parks & Recreation, a mile east of town on US 12: four cloverleaf loops among mature trees with a camp host, playground and picnic shelter. A rail line runs along the north edge. --Claude
summary: City camping page + city Campspot: 54 electric sites (20 FHU $40, 29 electric $30, $2 booking fee), tents $15, weekly/monthly; stays over 2 weeks need the director's approval. Showers, flush toilets, water, dump. Google 4.5 (76), recent reviews travelers. Nightly-oriented (all 49 RV units sold nightly on Campspot): passes. Rate conflict: the city page's fee table ($30 FHU / $25 electric) is older than Campspot's ($40/$30); Campspot kept. Season conflict flagged. Not waterfront stands. Pin OK.
